caption:
Toto swims breaststroke laps every morning, and lately the inside of his knee twinges with every kick.

The breaststroke kick opens and rotates the knees, which can pull on the inner knee. A narrower, smoother kick and building distance slowly can ease the load.

Hybi's tip: a few leg swings on deck, keep the kick narrow and smooth, and mix some freestyle into your laps.

A knee that swells, catches or keeps getting more painful is worth an assessment first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
